_note: The taxable interest on a person's own provident-fund contributions, under other sources (D-198; rulebook PF-EEINT-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 Schedule II Table Sl. 3 (a fund the Provident Funds Act, 1925 applies to, or one the Central Government notifies) and Sl. 4 (a recognised provident fund), column C: "(a) The income by way of interest accrued during the tax year shall not be eligible for exclusion from total income where,–– (i) it is attributable to the contribution (including aggregate thereof) made by that person on or after the 1st April, 2021; (ii) such contribution exceeds–– (A) ₹ 5,00,000 in a tax year in such fund where no contribution is made by the employer of such person; (B) ₹ 2,50,000 in other cases; and (b) … computed in such manner, as may be prescribed" (p.500; FA 2026 does not amend Sl. 3 or 4); Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.277(1): "Taxable interest … shall be computed as the interest accrued in the taxable contribution account during the tax year", the account being each year's contribution "in excess of the threshold limit" from 2021-22 with its interest, less withdrawals, and the threshold "₹500000 where no contribution is made by the employer of such person; and ₹250000 in other cases" (Gazette 271092 p.1775; no amendment, nor the corrigendum G.S.R. 286(E), touches it). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(11), (12) first and second provisos, inserted by FA 2021 s.6(d) w.e.f. 1-4-2022: "exceeding two lakh and fifty thousand rupees in any previous year in that fund, on or after the 1st day of April, 2021 and computed in such manner as may be prescribed", "five lakh rupees" where "there is no contribution by the employer of such person" (egazette 2021/226208 p.18); Rules 1962 r.9D, the same computation (G.S.R. 604(E), 31-8-2021, egazette 2021/229312 p.3, in force 1-4-2022). No provision prescribes the fund's rate or how it credits the account, so the interest is the fund's figure, entered (ProvidentFundAccount.taxableAccountInterest), and the year's excess over the threshold is measured per fund. Every regime: Schedule II and s.10(11), (12) are not among the regime's exclusions. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-17-pf-own-interest.md.
